required_steps: Install the exact APK on the physical Android phone
Launch Army Attack and confirm the main game loads
Recording starts automatically; PERF only opens or closes the metrics panel
Play a representative gameplay session including placement, right HUD, supply aircraft, PvP FireMission and PvP loot debrief
Press MARCAR LAG whenever a visible slowdown occurs
Press ZIP to share a snapshot without stopping the recording
Share the generated ZIP back for analysis
